title: feat: harden deserialization paths

bugs.summary: When compatible-mode metadata matches an exact local schema, the resolver builds a fresh TypeInfo with createMetaSharedTypeInfo and never stores it in typeInfoByHeaderHash (here and in buildMetaSharedTypeInfo / buildCachedMetaSharedTypeInfo). Only the single depth-local cached hint can be reused, so alternating sibling struct types recreate their TypeInfo and compatible serializer on every read, resubmitting code generation each time.
bugs.trigger: Deserializing, in compatible/meta-share mode, a stream that alternates two or more registered struct types whose remote TypeDef equals the local schema: each read of a type after another type was read builds a new TypeInfo instead of reusing the first one.
